title: Ringo Starr announces 2026 tour | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr has announced twelve new US tour dates for spring 2026 with the 16th All-Starr Band: Steve Lukather, Colin Hay, Warren Ham, Hamish Stuart, Gregg Bissonette, and Buck Johnson.

I am happy to be touring again in the Spring – see you all in June. Peace and love.
Ringo Starr

All-Starr Band 2026 tour dates

  • 28 May 2026: Pechanga Resort & Casino, Temecula, USA
  • 29 May 2026: Humphreys Concerts By The Bay, San Diego, USA
  • 31 May 2026: Findlay Toyota Center, Prescott Valley, USA
  • 1 June 2026: Eccles Theater, Salt Lake City, USA
  • 3 June 2026: Tucson Convention Center, Tucson, USA
  • 5 June 2026: Thunder Valley Casino Resort, Lincoln, USA
  • 6 June 2026: Vina Robles Amphitheatre, Paso Robles, USA
  • 8 June 2026: Kiva Auditorium, Albuquerque, USA
  • 9 June 2026: Bellco Theatre, Denver, USA
  • 11 June 2026: San Jose Civic, San Jose, USA
  • 12 June 2026: ASU Gammage, Tempe, USA
  • 14 June 2026: Greek Theatre, Los Angeles, USA
Page last updated: 16 June 2026
